subject: Mapping the neuro-metabolic circuit of hypoxia-induced longevity
script: From Agewell Brief: Mapping the neuro-metabolic circuit of hypoxia-induced longevity. Recent invertebrate research reveals how localized neuronal oxygen sensing coordinates a multi-tier endocrine relay to extend organismal lifespan. Organismal survival depends on how cells perceive and adapt to environmental insults over time. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
